sequence.cn: 简单来说，就是大家一起努力，但谁也没得到好处。
sequence.py: Jiǎndān lái shuō, jiùshì dàjiā yìqǐ nǔlì, dàn shéi yě méi dédào hǎochù.
sequence.en: Simply put, everyone works hard together, but no one gets any benefit.

sequence.cn: 就像看电影，前面的人站起来，后面的人也得站起来。
sequence.py: Jiù xiàng kàn diànyǐng, qiánmiàn de rén zhàn qǐlái, hòumiàn de rén yě děi zhàn qǐlái.
sequence.en: It's like at the movies: the person in front stands up, so everyone behind has to stand up too.

sequence.cn: 小明的公司本来六点下班。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Míng de gōngsī běnlái liù diǎn xiàbān.
sequence.en: Xiao Ming's company originally finished work at six.

sequence.cn: 有一天，一个同事为了表现，故意加班到八点。
sequence.py: Yǒu yìtiān, yí gè tóngshì wèile biǎoxiàn, gùyì jiābān dào bā diǎn.
sequence.en: One day, a coworker, to show off, deliberately worked overtime until eight.

sequence.cn: 结果第二天，所有人都不敢走了。
sequence.py: Jiéguǒ dì-èr tiān, suǒyǒu rén dōu bù gǎn zǒu le.
sequence.en: As a result, the next day, no one dared to leave.

sequence.cn: 一个星期后，大家都在公司待到半夜。
sequence.py: Yí gè xīngqī hòu, dàjiā dōu zài gōngsī dāi dào bànyè.
sequence.en: A week later, everyone stayed at the office until midnight.

sequence.cn: 可是工作还是那些工作，谁也没多赚一分钱。
sequence.py: Kěshì gōngzuò háishi nàxiē gōngzuò, shéi yě méi duō zhuàn yì fēn qián.
sequence.en: But the work was still the same work — no one earned a single cent more.

sequence.cn: 所以说，内卷就是——大家越来越累，结果还是一样。
sequence.py: Suǒyǐ shuō, nèi juǎn jiùshì—— dàjiā yuè lái yuè lèi, jiéguǒ háishi yíyàng.
sequence.en: So, 内卷 means: everyone gets more and more tired, but the result stays the same.
